mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'parking' LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY entered_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, reservation_id, spot_id, user_id, status, entered_at, parking_fee, charging_fee, total_amount, payment_status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{reservationId}, #{spotId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{enteredAt}, #{parkingFee}, #{chargingFee}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, exited_at = #{exitedAt}, parking_fee = #{parkingFee}, charging_fee = #{chargingFee}, total_amount = #{totalAmount} WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
UPDATE orders SET payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, paid_at = #{paidAt} WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
